modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ipmask: Client-side Fabric privacy mod that masks server addresses in address fields, LAN entries, server-list tooltips, chat, signs, holograms, GUI text, connection screens, and narration. YACL and Mod Menu are optional; server names are not masked.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.ipmask: Mask server addresses on screen to help prevent accidental leaks.
ipmask.config.title: IPMask Settings
ipmask.config.address_fields.description: Mask server addresses in Add Server, Edit Server, and Direct Connection fields. Copy and cut are blocked while the field is hidden.
ipmask.config.server_list.description: Mask addresses in LAN entries and server-list hover tooltips. Server names are intentionally unchanged.
ipmask.config.in_game_text.description: Mask the active server address in rendered text, including chat, signs, holograms, GUI text, and hover tooltips.
ipmask.config.narration.description: Mask the active server address in chat and system narration for screen readers.
ipmask.config.connection_screens.descrip: Mask the active server address on connecting and disconnection screens.
